title: Team matches
intro: Every league team match, division by division: the results, each match, the upsets and how strong each team was.
explanation: A team's strength is the lineup it played. Each match's win chance is from the players' ratings right before it, and together they give the team's chance of winning the team match. - A team match is an upset when the winner had less than a 30% chance. - A match is an upset by the same rules as the biggest upsets: between settled players.

match.explanation: Each player is shown with their rating before the match and the rating it gained or cost them. The bar under the score is each side's chance of winning the match, from the ratings right before it. Walkovers count as won by the side given them; matches not rated count for neither side.

power.title: Power ranking
power.intro: Matches won per team match, of {matches}: expected from the players who played for each team, and what actually happened.
power.expectedTitle: Expected matches won per team match against the group's other teams, with each team's best lineup
power.winTitle: Average chance of winning a team match against the group's other teams
power.playersTitle: Players who played for the team in the season
power.actualTitle: Matches actually won per team match in the group
power.how: - The squad: everyone who played for the team in the season, at their ratings in the week of {date}, the group's last team match. A missing doubles or mixed rating comes from the singles rating. - The lineup: the team's best in the group's format. The matches are filled one at a time with the player or pair that has the best chance against the group's average opponent. Each player plays at most two matches, and one per discipline. - The team matches: the teams meet lineup against lineup, match by match, with the same win chances as the ratings. A match a team can't field is a walkover. Expected is the matches won per team match, averaged over the group's other teams. Wins is the chance of winning a team match. Actual is the matches the team really won per team match, from the official scores. The squads are taken at full strength. So a team that seldom fielded its best players does worse than expected.
